title: How Much Protein Do You Actually Need? A UK Guide
excerpt: 57% of UK shoppers are chasing protein, but most already get enough. Here's who actually needs more, and who doesn't.
author: Bite Insight Team
meta_title: How Much Protein Do You Actually Need? | Bite Insight
meta_description: Protein is everywhere in UK shops right now. Here's what the evidence says about how much you really need, and who should eat more.
ai_summary: A UK focused breakdown of how much protein people actually need, cutting through the current high protein food trend. Covers the official RNI minimum, who genuinely benefits from eating more (older adults, people on weight loss medication, and those training hard), debunks the kidney damage myth, and compares budget friendly protein sources against pricier branded snacks.
